image_description: A close-up studio shot of an ornate, vintage-style necklace against a plain white background. The necklace features a central gold-toned heart-shaped locket pendant with an engraved floral design. The chain consists of elaborate metalwork segments containing pink oval cabochon stones and clear faceted beads, connected by smaller metallic links. The lighting is soft, highlighting the reflective surfaces of the metal and stones.

artifact_observations.location: Engraving on the gold heart locket
artifact_observations.reasoning: The floral engraving on the locket appears slightly soft and lacks the crisp, sharp edges typical of real metal stamping. It has a slight 'painted' or smeared quality rather than distinct cut lines.

artifact_observations.location: Connection point between the locket bail and the chain
artifact_observations.reasoning: The small ring (bail) attaching the locket to the chain appears somewhat fused or indistinct. The geometry of the connection is ambiguous, lacking a clear open loop structure, suggesting minor AI generation fusion.

The chain links on the far right edge seem to lose definition and merge slightly into the white background, exhibiting minor edge bleeding or focus falloff inconsistent with the rest of the sharp image.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a necklace and distinguish it from other jewelry types like brooches or bracelets.
To verify the physical connectivity of the chain links and the locket bail, ensuring they are separate, closed loops and not fused artifacts.
To analyze the realism of the metal reflections and the sharpness of the engraved details on the locket, checking for AI-smearing.

focus_areas: Connectivity of the locket bail to the chain
Sharpness and realism of the locket engraving
Distinctness of individual chain links vs. fusion
Reflective properties of the metal surfaces
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'bail' (the loop holding the pendant). AI often fails to render this as an open, separate ring, instead fusing it to the pendant or chain. Also, scrutinize the engraving on the heart; real metal engraving has sharp shadows and highlights, while AI often makes it look like a flat texture map.
